This task runs in `~/flakes/dsh-harness` (`factory-wave pa11 ~/flakes/dsh-harness "P13"` with `FACTORY_PLAN` naming this plan; the workspace is a clone of that repo, a repo without a flake and without hooks — `git config core.hooksPath` prints nothing and no `githooks/` ever existed there (Assumption 11), so the gate is the four commands below; commits via `nix develop /home/dalhaka/nixos-agent-env -c git commit -F <msgfile>`). `~/nixos-agent-env` is readable from the workspace and never written: the sandbox is `workspace-write`, the hook guard's only path rule is `refusing to edit/write …: outside the project directory`, and the guard itself reads `$HOME/nixos-agent-env/docs/ledger/routing.toml` from every workspace (Assumption 11). Below, `D=/home/dalhaka/nixos-agent-env/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-planning-agent-design.md`.

**Files (in ~/flakes/dsh-harness):**
- Create: `skills/planning/SKILL.md`, `skills/planning/references/inputs.md`, `skills/planning/references/rubric.md`, `skills/planning/references/anticipation.md`, `skills/planning/references/section-checklist.md`, `skills/planning/judge-prompt.md`.
- Modify: `skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md` (the description only), `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `skills/using-superpowers/references/dsh-tools.md`, `skills/subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md` (the role sentence in each), `CHANGELOG.md` (one dated line).

**Interfaces:**
- `skills/planning/SKILL.md` frontmatter: `name: planning`; `description: Write a typed implementation plan from an approved spec under docs/superpowers/specs for this house's dark factory; use when handed that spec path and an output path under docs/reviews/plan-drafts`. Body: the process is design §3 Steps 0–7 with the packet handed in (`tools/factory/seat/factory-plan-brief.sh` composes it; the seat never computes it); the rules in the skill's own words — one output file; no typed heading outside it; no read of transcripts, seat logs, `dispatch.log`, `.dsh-home` or store bodies; every fact beside its command, anchor text not line numbers; `tools/factory/seat/factory-brief <draft> <KEY>` is the one seat tool it may run and `factory-dispatch` only with `--dry-run`; the plan is a draft until the panel says otherwise; the eight questions of `references/section-checklist.md` answered per section before the draft is done.
- The reference files are extracted, not paraphrased — each starts with an HTML comment holding the command that produced it, then the text: `references/inputs.md` ← `awk '/^### 2.1/{s=1} /^## 3\. /{s=0} s' $D` (§2.1–2.4: the 29 table rows M1–M13, R1–R6, O1–O7, T1–T3 with their "if missing" column, kept as tables); `references/rubric.md` ← `awk '/^### 5.1/{s=1} /^### 5.2/{s=0} s' $D` (the 14-row table) followed by `awk '/^### 5.3/{s=1} /^### 5.4/{s=0} s' $D` (the threshold and the six-row floor); `references/anticipation.md` ← `awk '/^## 4\. /{s=1} /^## 5\. /{s=0} s' $D` (the A-rows, keyed by trigger as the design keys them); `references/section-checklist.md` ← `awk '/^## Appendix A/{s=1} /^## Appendix B/{s=0} s' $D` (23 lines); `judge-prompt.md` ← from `awk '/^## Appendix D/{s=1} /^## Revision/{s=0} s' $D`: the three `lens:` strings of `const LENSES` and the two sentences of `function judgePrompt`, one heading per lens, quoted as prose (no JavaScript).
- `skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md` description becomes: `Use when you have requirements for a multi-step task in a repository without a typed task graph (no docs/superpowers/plans directory), before touching code; house repos use the planning skill`.
- The role sentence in the four files becomes, byte-identical in each: `Roles: implement | review | verify | research | baseline | audit | plan; kind: code | docs;` (the rest of the paragraph unchanged); `plan` is documented in `README.md`'s "Model routing" as: kind `docs`, size by the spec's word count, no row yet — the lookup falls to the openrouter default.
- **The gate (whole tree minus the archive)**, each command recorded red (before) and green (after): (1) lockstep, on the sentence, not the line (two of the four lines are indented — Assumption 11) — `grep -rho --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=archive 'Roles: [^;]*; kind: [^;]*;' . | sort -u` prints exactly one line and `… | sort -u | grep -c '| plan;'` prints `1` (before: one line, the count `0`; a mutant that edits three of the four files → two lines); (2) one claimant, over the frontmatter only — `for f in skills/*/SKILL.md; do d=$(sed -n '2,/^---$/p' "$f" | sed -n 's/^description: //p' | head -1); printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qiw 'spec' && printf '%s' "$d" | grep -qiw 'plan' && echo "$f"; done` prints exactly `skills/planning/SKILL.md` (before: nothing — no frontmatter description holds both words; whole words and frontmatter only, because `writing-skills`' example lines hold `specific` and `explains`; mutant: drop `spec` from the planning description → prints nothing; a second skill claiming both → two lines); (3) the re-scope — `sed -n '2,/^---$/p' skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md | grep -c 'without a typed task graph'` prints `1` (before: `0`; mutant: leave `writing-plans` unchanged → `0`); (4) the archive suite still passes: `nix develop /home/dalhaka/nixos-agent-env -c node --test archive/2026-09-05-planning-factory/tests/*.test.mjs` (15 files).

**Facts (planning time):** the sentence `Roles: implement | review | verify | research | baseline | audit; kind: code | docs;` in exactly four files, `writing-plans`'s description, the harness layout and its H2c gate precedent (Assumption 11); the catalog reaches a seat through `~/.local/share/dsh-openrouter/skills` → `~/flakes/dsh-harness/skills`.

Paste them. **Step 2** Write the six skill files (the five extractions, then `SKILL.md`), re-scope `writing-plans`, edit the role sentence in the four files, the README paragraph, the CHANGELOG line. **Step 3: Green** — gates (1)–(4) recorded: `Roles: implement | review | verify | research | baseline | audit | plan; kind: code | docs;` and `1`; `skills/planning/SKILL.md`; `1`; the suite's `# pass` line. **Step 4: One commit.**
